data.body:
[P2] Enforce the declared recovery duration

Requirement 4 mandates `recoveryMs`, but recovery validation checks only ordering and peer occupancy. The driver uses this budget to check peer headroom, without bounding the actual recovery measurement. Consequently, matching manifest and evidence budgets of 14 ms still accept the existing positive fixture's 15 ms recovery. Require `worker_recovered.atMs <= platform_timeout.atMs + budgets.recoveryMs`, and add a regression that tightens both declared and retained budgets below the observed duration.
